dialogs.dialog_name: OFFICE/GROUP SELECT dialog (legacy title not documented)

elements.label: Select All
elements.notes: Selects every office of the list - the vendor-recommended way to run Executive Summary for all offices. `Select All` is the wording of the vendor's reporting guide (recommended parameters); the dialog itself is not shown in the document, so the on-screen label of this element may differ, and whether it is a checkbox, a link or a button is not documented.

dialogs.notes: Only this element is documented. The dialog is multi-select (for Income Allocation the document notes that multiple offices or a group are allowed). List columns, sort options, search fields and the Office Group variant are not documented. Documented for a Monthly report; the same SELECT button sits on the Management reports and - disabled by design - on the Ledger reports.

dialogs.dialog_name: FINANCE CHARGES (finance-charge run; legacy dialog title not documented)

elements.label: Finance Charge Date
elements.notes: Typed as a date from its label; default not documented.

elements.label: Responsible Party Range
elements.notes: Range of responsible parties; the inner controls are not documented (on the Statements screen the same caption covers Start Name / End Name, each with SEARCH).

elements.label: Exclude Responsible Party Type
elements.notes: Control form not documented (on the Statements screen: read-only box + SELECT).

elements.label: Apply Finance Charge to
elements.notes: Two documented choices; whether they are radios or a dropdown, and the default, are not documented.

dialogs.evidence_quote: `FINANCE CHARGES` | Opens the finance-charge run: `Finance Charge Date`, `Responsible Party Range`, `Exclude Responsible Party Type`, `Provider`, `Apply Finance Charge to` (`Patient Portion` / `Entire Balance`), `Apply`.
dialogs.notes: Not a SELECT / SEARCH picker: it is the separate finance-charge run behind the FINANCE CHARGES button, which the vendor sequence places before PRINT STATEMENT REPORT. Rates and thresholds are office settings (Setup > Offices > Office Setup > Advanced: Annual Fin. Charge %, Minimum Balance, Minimum Fin. Charge, # of Days Before Applying Fin. Charge), not fields of this dialog.

dialogs.opened_from: Audit Trail > OTHER OPTIONS > Module Type
dialogs.evidence_quote: `Module Type` (default `ALL`) | Module; `Appointments` is documented (used to list deleted appointments: look for `Delete Appointment-Created` in `Description`)
